title: Send references to Zotero
intro: Connect your personal library, choose a collection and send references when you decide. Nothing is sent automatically.
signIn: Sign in to manage your reference connection
scopes: Use a dedicated Zotero key with personal library read, note read and library write access. Leave file and group access off. Note read is needed to reconcile notes safely after an interrupted send. This library binds to your Keryx account; disconnecting retains that binding. Account transfer is unavailable.
disconnected: Connection revoked in Keryx. You can also delete the dedicated key in Zotero settings.
savedScope: This sends the saved paper metadata from this browser. Your review title, question, screening decisions and personal notes stay here.
reportLabel: Report ID from your research history
report: Send report references and cited excerpts
reportScope: This sends the owned report's canonical reference fields, public report link and exact recorded cited excerpts. Private originals are unavailable for this action.
confirm: Send these references and any cited excerpts to the selected Zotero collection? Zotero and anyone with access to that library may retain them.
sent: References accepted by Zotero. Repeated sends reconcile existing items and notes.
unavailable: Zotero sending is unavailable on this deployment.
failed: The operation did not finish. Some references may already have reached Zotero. Reload collections, then explicitly send again to reconcile them.
conflict: The send contains overlapping citation identities or the library has conflicting, duplicate or changed references. Review the references before sending again.
libraryBound: This Zotero library is already bound to another Keryx account. Disconnecting does not release that binding. Account transfer is unavailable.
scopesFailed: The key needs only personal library read, note read and write access, with file and group access off. Check the dedicated key in Zotero settings.
backoff: Zotero requested a pause. Wait before trying another action.
notFound: This report is unavailable for your account or contains a private original.
boundary: Disconnecting stops future Keryx requests and removes its stored key. It cannot recall items already sent or a request already in flight.
